Create a polished hero / banner illustration for PicSee, a fast native macOS image viewer. This image is the top-right visual of a product landing page, coordinating with a five-feature illustration set. Canvas LANDSCAPE 6:5 aspect ratio, ideally 1440x1200. ART DIRECTION: Premium soft 3D product illustration. Porcelain-white rounded floating photo cards, small powder-blue sculptural interaction elements, gentle isometric perspective, realistic vivid photographs inset into cards, beautiful soft ambient occlusion and broad daylight, clean warm off-white #F7F7F4 studio. Playful but sophisticated. No clutter. MAIN PHOTOGRAPH: sunlit turquoise Mediterranean cove, limestone cliffs, small white sailboat. COMPOSITION: three beautifully arranged overlapping photo viewer cards with refined depth, central front card is largest, two secondary cards offset behind to the upper right and left. Front photograph is breathtaking, natural, crisp and richly detailed, main scene above. Rear cards show two complementary natural destinations. Picture viewing is the entire story: no text, no letters, no logos, no title, no caption, no OCR highlights, no crop box, no magnifier, no diagrams, no arrows. A very small floating white toolbar centered just beneath the front card, containing only four delicate blue line icons for fit-to-window, zoom out, zoom in, rotate. For the native-window style use thin macOS chrome with tiny traffic lights; for other styles adapt framing to art direction. Sophisticated balanced composition with soft realistic shadows, pristine off-white background, consistent materials, 12% safe margin around all subjects so no part touches or crosses the canvas edge. Main group occupies about 75% canvas. Premium finished marketing illustration, restrained and beautiful, immediately recognizable as a lightweight image viewer. Not a webpage screenshot, not a contact sheet.
